summary.project_stage: Computer-based design studies; not a proven complete reactor
summary.change_statement: The latest scientific test exposed a mismatch in the plasma assumptions. The later graphs, animations and access fixes improve the tools, not fusion performance.
summary.timeline_notice: Historical dates are recorded study dates. The next-work timeline is a dependency order, not promised completion dates. No unattended research worker is implied.

event_scope: All existing dated public project milestones from 7–16 September 2026, explicitly classified. Older work remains in the research library; this is not a log of every action.

events.title: A more complete reference calculation
events.result: Added the intended magnet-lifetime requirement to the whole-plant calculation.
events.decision: Keep this as the numerical reference; do not reuse the earlier optimistic power screen.
events.limit: Numerical lifetime and output, not a qualified magnet or working reactor.

events.title: Accounting and evidence made inspectable
events.result: Reviewed established confinement/accounting conventions and made reports searchable.
events.decision: Use the corrected conventions; do not count the same finding as new physics.
events.limit: This does not demonstrate a better plasma or new generated power.

events.title: Pipe placement changes a local result
events.result: Compared two pipe arrangements in a simplified particle-transport section.
events.decision: Do not approve the more convenient cooling layout without its neutron effects.
events.limit: A local calculated effect, not whole-reactor fuel supply.

events.title: Made the particle results visible
events.result: Linked saved particle paths and deposited-energy fields to the 3D views.
events.decision: Use the replay to inspect a calculation that already exists.
events.limit: Adding animation is not a new physical result.

events.title: The local pipe penalty survives a better source model
events.result: Used candidate-linked particle directions instead of only simple angle assumptions.
events.decision: The front-pipe layout still cannot be approved on cooling alone.
events.limit: Source geometry and surrounding-material return effects remain incomplete.

events.title: Found the relevant work already published
events.result: Identified the existing tritium-production benchmark study and credited its authors.
events.decision: Reuse it; do not invent a new benchmark or borrow its discrepancy as a reactor correction.
events.limit: Finding prior work does not validate our reactor.

events.title: A software replay exposed a measurement gap
events.result: Recovered an existing lithium calculation and checked its comparison data.
events.decision: Separate reproduction of a calculation from agreement with measurement.
events.limit: No whole-reactor breeding validation or new power.

events.title: A conditional power lead worth testing
events.result: A fixed-radius comparison predicted higher output if more heating can also drive current.
events.decision: Test that physical capability before accepting the modeled gain.
events.limit: The condition is unproven. This is not electricity generated.

events.title: The plasma assumptions did not line up
events.result: The detailed constructed magnetic fields did not match the simpler design assumptions.
events.decision: Do not treat the higher-power estimate as proven. Test a consistent plasma/current model next.
events.limit: The simplified constructions do not prove the original concept impossible.

events.title: Published power history and external experiments
events.result: Made existing model records and others’ measurements easier to inspect.
events.decision: Keep the two evidence types separate and preserve failures.
events.limit: The dashboard added no scientific power point.

events.title: Explained the research and opened the animation
events.result: Put the concept and recorded particles in a plain-language entry.
events.decision: Make clear that we have not produced fusion or electricity.
events.limit: A usability improvement, not progress in reactor performance.

events.title: Added a progress graph and gated roadmap
events.result: Made existing decisions, setbacks, future goals and reuse rules visible together.
events.decision: Review the actual next question before spending compute; keep app work separate.
events.limit: This graph and plan are not a new fusion result or an executed scientific study.

goals.title: Agree on one consistent plasma input
goals.deliverable: A versioned boundary, pressure and current-profile packet with units, assumptions and source hashes.
goals.pass_rule: Every required profile is supplied or explicitly labeled an unqualified assumption; no hidden substitution of a different plasma. Numerical tolerances and a finite run budget are written before execution.
goals.stop_rule: Stop qualification when essential inputs are missing. A proxy may be tested only under a separately labeled, decision-relevant admission.
missing_inputs: Separated inductive / self-generated / driven current profiles
Substantiated fast-particle pressure and control requirements

goals.title: Make the plasma-current calculation agree with itself
goals.checkpoint: Next bounded candidate calculation, after G1
goals.deliverable: A reproducible equilibrium/current comparison with failed and successful cases retained.
goals.pass_rule: Current and pressure profiles are mutually consistent under stated tolerances and assumptions. Either support the intended operating point or report a named redesign; do not fit a scalar merely to restore the desired power.
goals.stop_rule: Reject or revise the operating point when closure or compatibility fails. Keep nonconvergence distinct from proof of impossibility.

goals.title: Test whether the heating can do both jobs
goals.checkpoint: After a consistent candidate plasma is available
goals.deliverable: Actual ray, absorption and driven-current profiles with the retained heating/control functions.
goals.pass_rule: Meet the approximately 7.598 MA external-current requirement within 170 MW credited drive power AND the required heating/control/current-profile conditions. The current total alone is insufficient.
goals.stop_rule: Reject or reduce the higher-power allocation if those functions cannot coexist; do not import current from the unrelated ITER reference.
missing_inputs: Qualified launch geometry and power definition

goals.title: Check cooling, fuel and materials on that same design
goals.checkpoint: Prior-data review can proceed now; full design integration follows G2/G3
goals.deliverable: One traceable nuclear-to-thermal/fuel/structural model, with benchmark support and missing data explicit.
goals.pass_rule: Use the same geometry and source throughout; satisfy stated cooling, fuel-recovery and material limits without mixing favorable results from different designs.
goals.stop_rule: Do not promote the design when fuel/cooling/material constraints fail or the experimental comparison is unsupported.

goals.title: Obtain relevant physical validation
goals.checkpoint: Only after a credible design and an authorized measurement plan
goals.deliverable: Independent, calibrated physical tests of the relevant design claims, with uncertainty and provenance.
goals.pass_rule: A qualified partner or facility tests the relevant claims; unrelated laboratory records and simulations do not count as our hardware result.
goals.stop_rule: No hardware or fusion claim without traceable measurements and the necessary resources and approvals.

goals.title: Demonstrate useful net electricity
goals.checkpoint: No credible completion date is established
goals.deliverable: An independently checked complete energy account over operation, including internal loads.
goals.pass_rule: Measured electricity delivered exceeds electricity consumed at the declared whole-system boundary over the stated period; shot yield or a model estimate is not enough.
goals.stop_rule: Do not declare success from reaction energy, target gain, or positive hypothetical plant power.

plan_notice: Past dates are factual study dates. Future order is dependency-based. No reactor-completion date, start booking or unattended worker is implied.
plan_status: Proposed next-work checkpoints based on the open research tasks; not executed by this dashboard

prior_work.policy: Search this register and primary literature before admitting new work. Replication is useful only when it closes a named reproducibility or validation gap. These entries are not an exhaustive novelty search.

entries.our_use: Make best conditional modeled net electricity and its limitations visible without ranking it against measured reaction energy or peak fusion power.
entries.already_known: MJ yield, peak fusion MW, mean reaction MW, target gain and net electric MW are distinct physical boundaries. The original experimental records belong to their investigators.
entries.do_not_repeat: Do not label the superseded406.53MW cross-study estimate as a coupled best result. Do not turn absent measurements into zero, NIF shot energy into continuous power, or a new report into a new power point.
